integrity: The all-length proof reduces the observation to symbol counts and run counts and counts every feasible run profile. A bundled standalone verifier recomputes the literal observations through length 16 and checks the formulas independently through length 500. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to binary words and the two-length-limited observation. It does not give exact maxima for larger fixed observation lengths, larger alphabets, noisy observations, or a canonical ranking algorithm for representatives.
title: Exact binary \(r=2\) length-limited composition reconstruction
